resolution.rationale: v2.2.2 changes these files for live MCP status, pre-session hook trust, the AIR sessionIndex extension, and app-server recovery. None of them implements goal opt-in for non-AIR clients; upstream PR #583 is still open. The original commit replays cleanly on v2.2.2 and its added and removed lines are unchanged.

v2.2.2 adds the SessionIndexService imports directly before the async task import in src/CodexAcpServer.ts, and the patch edits the same capability lines as goal-opt-in. The adaptation is stacked on the goal-opt-in binding; every added and removed line is identical to 1681701. v2.2.2 has no provider-neutral async task negotiation.

v2.2.2 adds app-server crash and provider restart recovery: goal control now awaits ensureSessionReady, and a restarted app-server has a new client. 9d2c300 kept one subscription per session, so after a restart goal work from the new app-server was dropped. The adaptation binds the pre-prompt subscription to its client, subscribes again on the installed client, and cancels its permission requests and elicitations when that app-server dies. Upstream PR #584 is still open.
